How it works

From answers to a plan in under two minutes

Tell us about your body and your life. Nutri-Fit does the maths — you just follow the plan.

01

Share your details

Age, weight, height, goal, food preferences, equipment and how many days you can actually train. Honest inputs, honest plan — no twenty-question interrogation.

Takes ~2 minutes
02

Get your numbers

We calculate your BMR, maintenance calories (TDEE), target intake and macro split — protein, carbs and fats tuned precisely to your goal.

BMR · TDEE · Macros
03

Train, eat, adjust

Follow daily meals and workouts. As your body changes, your plan recalibrates every week so progress never stalls and plateaus never stick.

Recalibrated weekly

Questions

Before you start

No. Every plan can be built for home with bodyweight or dumbbells only. Tell the builder where you train and the split adapts — exercises, sets and progressions included.

Yes. Choose Vegetarian in the builder and your protein targets are met with paneer, lentils, Greek yoghurt, tofu, eggs (if you eat them) and smart combinations — no chicken breast copy-paste. Eggetarian and Vegan options are built in too.

Most members see measurable change in 3–4 weeks: roughly 0.4–0.8 kg per week for fat loss, or steady strength gains for muscle building. The builder shows an honest estimate for your numbers — no miracle promises.

Your plan flexes. Switch any week to "travel mode" for hotel-room workouts and restaurant-friendly meal rules, then pick up exactly where you left off.

Anytime, in two taps, no calls or dark patterns. Your plan history and progress data remain accessible on the free tier.
